name: academic-pipeline
description: v0.8.0: An optional Stage 10 deposits a paper's artifacts on Zenodo, one record and DOI per artifact from one artifact repository, through scripts/zenodo_deposit.py: drafts by default, publication only on the user's explicit word, the token read on the user's machine and never printed, the reserved DOI written into the archive before publishing, and the DOI written into the Stage 7 BibTeX file and draft before Stages 7 and 9 rerun. New /academic-deposit command. v0.6.0: Stage 5 now plans the end matter and Stage 6 writes it, closing a gap where the required sections were declared in stage four and produced by no stage at all. Stage 6 numbers Vancouver citations by first appearance while drafting. Stage 7 dedupes on normalized DOI or URL rather than on BibTeX key. A new Stage 9 release gate runs five named checks and blocks the completion report when any fails. v0.5.0: Reader-facing deliverables are named from the run's target slug rather than a constant, so a paper lands in the vault under its own title. The formatting skill no longer carries a worked example with a person's name in it, after a fabricated surname was found in the author block. End-to-end academic content pipeline: BibTeX theme mapping, perspective and voice capture, Academia.edu formatting, structure planning, iterative drafting, bibliography generation, and a 10-phase professor critique. Voice-first — authentic voice and journal formatting are fixed before drafting, never retrofitted.
